blurb.en: Everything for your wedding, handled by one team.

subtitle.en: Six services, one team, one number to call.

about.en: This is the package most families take, because it removes the job of coordinating separate vendors. Decoration, catering, photography, video, the printed album and the edit all run off one plan and one schedule, so the caterer knows when the ceremony will overrun and the photographer knows when the food is being served. You deal with one person throughout, and there is nobody left to chase on the day.

conditions.en: Photo editing can be added; any service can be swapped out on a call

blurb.en: The four essentials: decoration, catering, photography and videography.

about.en: The essential four — your venue decorated, your guests fed, and the ceremony photographed and filmed, all run off one coordinated schedule. The printed album and video edit aren't included at this level; add them separately, or step up to Silver or Gold to have them built in.

blurb.en: Everything in Bronze, plus a designed and printed photo album.

about.en: Builds on the Bronze essentials by adding a professionally designed and printed photo album, so the day is kept in print as well as on screen — still all coordinated by one team.

blurb.en: The complete package — every service, including full photo and video editing.

about.en: Nothing left to arrange separately: decoration, catering, photography, videography, the printed album, and both photo and video editing, all run by one team on one schedule. Built for couples who want the entire day handled end to end.

blurb.en: Every memory captured, edited and printed.

subtitle.en: Everything that outlives the day, from shoot to printed album.

about.en: Take this when the hall and the food are already arranged and you only need the recording side handled. The same team shoots the photographs and the video, which matters more than it sounds — two crews from different companies end up standing in each other's frames. Editing and the printed album are included, so nothing is left half finished after the wedding.

conditions.en: Pre-wedding shoot and drone coverage available as add-ons

blurb.en: Photography and videography coverage for the day.

about.en: Just the shoot — one crew covering both photography and video for the ceremony and reception. Editing and the album aren't included at this level; add them separately, or step up to Silver or Gold to have them built in.

blurb.en: Adds full photo and video editing to the shoot.

about.en: Everything in Bronze, with both the photographs and the video professionally edited afterward — colour-corrected stills and a finished, edited film rather than raw footage.

blurb.en: The complete package — shoot, full editing, and a printed album.

about.en: The full photo-and-video experience: the shoot, complete editing for both photos and video, and a printed album to finish it off. Nothing from the day is left unedited or undelivered.

blurb.en: We dress the venue and feed your guests.

subtitle.en: The hall dressed and the guests fed, run by one team.

about.en: Decoration and catering are the two jobs that need the venue at the same time, and running them separately is where most wedding-day arguments start. Booked together, one team plans the floor: where the counters go, how the guests move, and which lighting is on while the food is served. Handy if you already have your own photographer.

conditions.en: Guest count can be adjusted up to 3 days before the function

blurb.en: Standard decor and a set menu for up to 100 guests.

about.en: Standard decoration for the stage and entrance, paired with a set catering menu for up to 100 guests, run by one team on one floor plan.

blurb.en: Fuller venue decor and an expanded menu.

about.en: Decoration extended to cover more of the venue — pillars and additional seating areas — alongside a catering menu expanded with more dishes and a live counter.

blurb.en: Full venue decor and a premium multi-course menu.

about.en: The full venue dressed top to bottom, paired with a premium multi-course menu including live counters and dessert stations — the complete decor-and-catering experience for a larger guest list.
